title: The Stall With No Name
subtitle: alias: the_old_name
description: The stall has operated under four names in three years and the
market's ledger has stopped keeping up: this quest carries
name it used to have still resolve.
An alias is how a rename does not orphan progress or break a
dependency -- and the glazier next door writes its dependency
against `the_old_name` rather than against this quest's id, which
is the demonstration that a second name resolves everywhere a
first one does. Aliases exist at all three levels: quest, chapter,
